errors.text: The proposed 10–50 g Vickers loads do not match the target measurement of 0.05 kN, which is approximately 5.1 kgf, and hardness-versus-milling-time alone cannot isolate grain-boundary strengthening from precipitation hardening.

The cited evidence concerns NbMoTaWVTi, NbMoCrTiAl, and AlCoCrFeNiTi0.5 rather than equiatomic CoCrFeNiTi, so it does not substantiate the claimed six-hour BCC-to-FCC transition, HCP suppression, or numerical process window.
The asserted Ti-rich HCP precipitation threshold above 1100°C is speculative and not established by the supplied evidence or the target results.
The SPS heating rate is given as 100°C/min rather than the target 50°C/min, while key milling conditions of 400 rpm and a 20:1 ball-to-powder ratio are omitted.
